en.headline: Customs seize 450,000 dollars of suspected medicines at border
en.dek: A 37-year-old woman driver was charged with attempting to export unmanifested cargo and was due at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Thursday.
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers intercepted an outbound private car at a boundary control point on Wednesday and found a batch of suspected pharmaceutical products in several black plastic bags in the boot.
The goods were estimated to be worth about 450,000 dollars. After investigation, officers arrested the 37-year-old woman who was driving the car.
Customs said she was charged with one count of attempting to export unmanifested cargo and was due to appear at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Thursday.

The department said it would keep using risk assessment and intelligence to act against cross-boundary smuggling. Under the Import and Export Ordinance, importing or exporting unmanifested cargo can bring a fine of up to 2 million dollars and seven years in prison on conviction.

zh.headline: 海關口岸截私家車 檢約45萬元懷疑藥劑製品
zh.dek: 一名37歲女司機被控企圖輸出未列艙單貨物，案件星期四在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，人員星期三根據風險評估，在口岸截查一輛出境私家車，在車尾箱數個黑色膠袋內檢獲一批懷疑藥劑製品。
海關估計該批貨品市值約45萬元，調查後拘捕涉案的37歲女司機。
海關稱，她被控一項企圖輸出未列艙單貨物罪，星期四在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關表示會繼續透過風險評估和情報分析打擊跨境走私。根據《進出口條例》，輸入或輸出未列艙單貨物，一經定罪，最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁七年。
